T: More human than human. Same for the noodles.
D: A replicant blade runner finds a secret that could change the world, and goes looking for the man who vanished thirty years ago.
P: Serve the drinks when K finds Deckard in the empty Las Vegas casino.
S: Grilled white miso and garlic chicken thigh skewers with a soy sesame dip
Chicken thighs marinated in miso and garlic, threaded on skewers and grilled until charred, served with a sesame dipping sauce.
Pan-fried pork and cabbage gyoza with soy, black vinegar and chili oil
Pork and cabbage gyoza pan-fried until crisp underneath, steamed with a splash of water, with soy and black vinegar dipping sauce and chilli oil.
Wooden horse soft pretzels with mustard
the small wooden horse K carves into his memory

Soft pretzel twists dipped in bicarb water, sprinkled with rock salt and baked deep brown, served warm with a honey and wholegrain mustard dip. Mix 400g plain flour, 7g dried yeast, 1 tsp sugar, 1 tsp salt and 250ml warm water, knead 8 minutes and prove 1 hour. Divide into 8, roll into long ropes and twist into pretzels. Boil 2L water with 60g bicarb soda and dip each pretzel for 30 seconds. Sprinkle with rock salt and bake at 220C for 12 minutes. Mix 3 tbsp wholegrain mustard with 2 tbsp honey to dip.
M: Joi's rib eye, mash and red wine jus
Seared rib eye, buttery mashed potatoes, green beans and red wine jus
Pan-seared rib eye, buttered mash and green beans, plated like a proper dinner for two the way Joi pictures it, a red wine jus poured over.
Off-world miso ramen with pork belly
the off-world ads glowing over the rainy city

Ramen noodles in a rich pork and miso broth with seared soy-braised pork belly, jammy soy eggs, corn, nori and spring onion. Simmer 600g pork belly in 100ml soy, 100ml mirin and 500ml water for 90 minutes, then slice and sear. Boil 4 eggs for 6.5 minutes, peel and soak in some of the braising liquid. Heat 1.5L chicken stock, whisk in 4 tbsp white miso and 2 tbsp of the braising liquid. Cook 4 portions of ramen noodles. Fill bowls with noodles and broth and top with pork, halved eggs, corn, nori and spring onion.
W: Vanilla panna cotta in glasses with crushed meringue on top
Vanilla bean panna cotta set in glasses overnight, topped with crushed meringue scattered like snow.
K: Scotch, honey syrup and lemon topped with cold ginger ale

Scotch whisky stirred with honey syrup and lemon, poured long over ice and topped with ginger ale, finished with a strip of lemon peel. Stir 2 tbsp honey into 2 tbsp hot water to loosen and cool. Fill four tall glasses with ice. Into each pour 45ml Scotch whisky, 10ml honey syrup and 10ml lemon juice and stir. Top each with 120ml cold ginger ale and stir once more. Twist a strip of lemon peel over the top and drop it in.

s.note: Grilled white miso and garlic chicken thigh skewers with a soy sesame dip
s.how: Marinate 600g diced chicken thighs in 2 tbsp white miso and 2 crushed garlic cloves for an hour. Thread onto skewers and grill until charred. Mix soy, sesame oil and spring onion for dipping. No grubs, promise.

s.note: Pan-fried pork and cabbage gyoza with soy, black vinegar and chili oil
s.how: Mix 400g pork mince with 2 cups shredded wombok, salted and squeezed. Fill 30 dumpling wrappers and pleat. Fry until crisp underneath, add water and steam 4 minutes. Serve with soy, black vinegar and chilli oil.

m.n: Joi's rib eye, mash and red wine jus
m.note: Seared rib eye, buttery mashed potatoes, green beans and red wine jus
m.how: Sear 2 rib eyes hard, rest and slice. Mash 1kg potatoes with butter. Steam 300g green beans. Reduce 150ml red wine with 250ml stock into a jus. Plate it like a proper dinner and pour the jus over.

w.note: Vanilla panna cotta in glasses with crushed meringue on top
w.how: Soak 3 gelatine sheets. Warm 400ml cream, 200ml milk, 80g sugar and a split vanilla bean, then stir in the gelatine. Set in glasses overnight. Crush 2 meringue nests over the top like falling snow.

d.note: Scotch, honey syrup and lemon topped with cold ginger ale
d.how: Stir 2 tbsp honey into 2 tbsp hot water to loosen and cool. Fill four tall glasses with ice. Into each pour 45ml Scotch whisky, 10ml honey syrup and 10ml lemon juice and stir. Top each with 120ml cold ginger ale and stir once more. Twist a strip of lemon peel over the top and drop it in.
